record.question: What exact boardwalk circulation and Kings Creek alternative should a complete Bumpass Hell visitor traversal use?
record.reason: The official dataset supports a connected 1.29564925-mile approach from the Bumpass Hell parking area to the basin entry. Separate boardwalk branches and a trail continuing east share the basin endpoint, while NPS describes a second overlook and a Kings Creek alternative without an unambiguous atomic visitor path in this batch. The published three-mile round-trip profile may include basin circulation not represented by the two approach features, so Wayproof does not force their values to match.
